# Noto Sans

- **Files:** `NotoSans-Regular.ttf` and `NotoSans-Bold.ttf`, unchanged.
  - `blockwright --screenshot` uses them as the window's UI font (PLAN §9), so its pictures don't depend on the fonts a machine has, except where the window's own widgets draw block or shade glyphs (█ ▓ ▒ ░), which Noto Sans lacks: Qt draws those in a system font, which can change those widgets' heights and so shift the docks round them by a pixel or two, and text that wraps round them can wrap differently. The program carries them in its Qt resources (`:/ui-font/`). The editor itself keeps the system UI font.
  - The app tests load the same resources (`UiFont` in `tests/test_app_workspace.cpp`), so the Tool Options layout tests measure the same font on every machine.
- **Source:** Noto Sans v2.015, <https://github.com/notofonts/latin-greek-cyrillic>, release `NotoSans-v2.015` (`https://github.com/notofonts/latin-greek-cyrillic/releases/download/NotoSans-v2.015/NotoSans-v2.015.zip`, SHA-256 `0c34df072a3fa7efbb7cbf34950e1f971a4447cffe365d3a359e2d4089b958f5`), files `NotoSans/hinted/ttf/NotoSans-Regular.ttf` (SHA-256 `478c558ea716033cd60c03438f628dfa75694dcf6b5f6d505a2f05fd2b4f3823`), `NotoSans/hinted/ttf/NotoSans-Bold.ttf` (SHA-256 `1df075a380fc7cb898acf64c1f7b3b4dd780de3caa860178bf929de35817a913`) and `OFL.txt` (SHA-256 `cee9892f9f0cc8fe882c9e9537ee6a89621d86ee7ceaf70b02e2b2b1c25c061a`).
- **Licence:** SIL Open Font License 1.1, with no Reserved Font Name; the copyright notice and the full text are in `OFL.txt`, as shipped in the release. An install carries both in `share/doc/blockwright/noto-sans/`.
